question: Does MCTS-guided Stage-2 training improve VH-off policy coverage?
headline: No domain survives five-domain Holm correction; Counters is positive in mean but highly variable.

question: Does inference-time MCTS improve VH-off coverage?
headline: Stage-1 FO Counters gains significantly; Block Grouping short budgets and Counters show MCTS is not uniformly safe. Stage-2 FO remains incomplete.

question: Does the value head improve Stage-2 refinement?
headline: Neither the direct VH-on refinement effect nor its interaction against VH-off is Holm-significant; Block Grouping has the clearest negative tendency.

question: Does the value head change the benefit of inference-time MCTS?
headline: Report both VH-on MCTS-versus-policy and the interaction against VH-off. Drone has the clear positive Stage-2 interaction; FO Stage-2 remains incomplete.
